verdict.rationale: The only evidence of language bindings is one user report of using llama.cpp through "python wrappers" (comm-9), with nothing showing they are official. The project also ships `llama serve` / Server (gh-2, gh-18), but the pack documents no HTTP API that clients could call. Otherwise the product is presented as a plain C/C++ library (gh-5, gh-17). Missing for 10: official first-party Python or JavaScript client libraries, a documented client-callable server API, and corroboration that any bindings are maintained by the project.
